claims.claim: The amendment and roadmap record TASK-425 as the single prospective NEXT for default bounded continuation across all three coding operations, retaining historical lineage and phase retirements.

Ordinary entrypoints select the source-bound default after independent family admission without additional KA-01 consent fields; unsupported providers, actions, observers and changed authority fail closed.

Codex PRIMARY, coding REPAIR and CODE_FIX REMEDIATION share the existing live-session Runtime continuation path, preserving operation-specific scope, claims, verification and executorless completion semantics.
The default shares the existing finite budgets, causal progress, receipt and crash guards, and consumes the final checkpoint through the original terminal writer without repeating final verification.
Historical typed modes and their normative pin remain supported separately from the prospective default; existing Runtime owners are not automatically enrolled.

Focused test definitions cover all three ordinary default entrypoints, mandatory installed-Codex continuation cases and negative guards, while retaining the existing v3 installed-native test without skip, xfail or native substitution.
Runtime observations include operation-bound policy, source, session, checkpoint, correction and STOP facts, while completion retains the ordinary independent review and publication handoff.
